name: Little Plane
description: A little taildragger and its runway: fly it around the room. It flies slowly, so it's easy indoors. Quest hands: look at the plane and hold one hand out flat like it, still, for 3 seconds; then tilt it up or down to climb or dive, roll it to bank (that turns it; on the ground it steers). Your thumb is the throttle: tucked along your fingers = full power, stuck out = engine off (and brakes on the ground). Land on the runway, a table or the floor; walls and furniture crash it (look at the runway with a flat hand to bring it back). Controllers: right stick pitch + roll, left stick rudder, right trigger throttle, left trigger brakes. Everyone in the space flies their own plane.

settings.label: Easy flying
settings.help: Levels the wings when you let go, stops stalls

gestures.name: Little Plane
gestures.how: Look at the plane, hold a hand out flat and still for 3 s; thumb = throttle
gestures.more: Look at the plane and hold one hand out flat, palm down, fingers forward, and keep it still for 3 seconds (the runway sign counts down; moving the hand starts the count over): the plane is yours. Tilt your fingers up to climb, down to dive; roll your hand to bank (that's how it turns; on the ground it steers). Thumb tucked along your fingers = full power; stuck straight out = engine off, and on the ground the brakes go on. Halfway = half power. Drop your hand and the plane flies itself level. Take off from the runway and land on it, on a table or on the floor; touching anything else is a crash: to bring it back, look at the runway and hold a hand out flat (controllers: the trigger).
